tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.description: A conversational assistant for drafting, explaining, brainstorming and working through problems.
tools.bestFor: Turn a rough idea into a clear plan or first draft.
tools.consider: Check factual answers and important calculations.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: Work through documents, writing and complex questions in a conversational workspace.
tools.bestFor: Discuss a document and refine a thoughtful written response.
tools.consider: Document limits and available features depend on the plan.

tools.name: Google Gemini
tools.description: Google’s assistant for everyday questions, ideas and supported Google-connected tasks.
tools.bestFor: Get help with planning and work across supported Google tools.
tools.consider: Connected-app availability depends on your account and region.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.description: A conversational assistant for exploring ideas, answering questions and creating content.
tools.bestFor: Get a starting point for an everyday question or creative task.
tools.consider: Consumer Copilot and Microsoft 365 offerings have different features.

tools.name: Mistral Vibe (Le Chat)
tools.description: Mistral’s conversational assistant for writing, answering questions and exploring information.
tools.bestFor: Try an alternative general-purpose assistant for everyday work.
tools.consider: Verify generated answers against reliable sources.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.description: Search the web with conversational answers and links to supporting sources.
tools.bestFor: Get oriented on a topic and follow the original sources.
tools.consider: A citation does not guarantee that an answer interprets it correctly.

tools.name: Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)
tools.description: Explore, summarize and ask questions about a collection of your own sources.
tools.bestFor: Study a set of documents and generate source-grounded summaries.
tools.consider: Answers depend on the sources you provide.
tools.keywords: study pdf documents summarize summary notes learn

tools.name: Elicit
tools.description: Find research papers and organize evidence for literature reviews.
tools.bestFor: Compare findings across academic papers.
tools.consider: Check extracted findings against the full paper.
tools.keywords: papers academic science literature evidence study

tools.name: Consensus
tools.description: Search scientific literature and explore research-based answers to questions.
tools.bestFor: Find what published studies say about a specific question.
tools.consider: Not a substitute for expert medical or scientific judgment.

tools.name: Scite
tools.description: Explore research and how scientific publications cite one another.
tools.bestFor: Investigate the citation context around a research claim.
tools.consider: Citation classifications need interpretation, not just counting.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.description: Writing assistance for clarity, grammar, tone and revision.
tools.bestFor: Polish an email, document or professional message.
tools.consider: Review suggested edits to keep your intended meaning.

tools.name: QuillBot
tools.description: Writing tools for paraphrasing, checking grammar and summarizing text.
tools.bestFor: Rephrase a draft and improve its readability.
tools.consider: Paraphrasing does not remove the need to credit sources.

tools.name: DeepL Write
tools.description: Refine phrasing, grammar and style with AI writing suggestions.
tools.bestFor: Make an existing draft clearer and more natural.
tools.consider: Supported writing languages differ from DeepL Translator.

tools.name: DeepL Translator
tools.description: Translate text and supported documents between languages.
tools.bestFor: Translate a document or understand text in another language.
tools.consider: Check technical terms and important translations with a fluent speaker.

tools.name: Jasper
tools.description: AI tools for teams creating and managing marketing content.
tools.bestFor: Create marketing copy around a consistent brand voice.
tools.consider: Best suited to a marketing workflow, not general research.
tools.keywords: marketing copy blog brand writing campaign

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.description: Generate visual concepts and images from creative direction.
tools.bestFor: Explore an artistic direction or concept for a project.
tools.consider: Check current commercial-use terms before publishing assets.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.description: Adobe’s generative creative workspace for images and other supported media tasks.
tools.bestFor: Create and refine visual assets in an Adobe-oriented workflow.
tools.consider: Features, credits and licensing vary by model and plan.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.description: Generate images and explore designs that incorporate lettering.
tools.bestFor: Draft a poster or visual concept with text.
tools.consider: Always proofread generated lettering.
tools.keywords: poster typography text logo image design

tools.name: Leonardo.Ai
tools.description: Generate and refine images for creative projects and visual concepts.
tools.bestFor: Explore illustrations, concept art and visual variations.
tools.consider: Check image visibility and licensing settings before use.
tools.keywords: art illustration image game concept photo

tools.name: Recraft
tools.description: Create and edit visual assets, including vector-style and raster designs.
tools.bestFor: Build a consistent set of illustrations or design assets.
tools.consider: Inspect exported files and commercial-use terms for your project.
tools.keywords: vector logo illustration graphic design image

tools.name: Runway
tools.description: Generative video tools for creating and transforming moving images.
tools.bestFor: Turn a visual idea into a short video experiment.
tools.consider: Expect iteration; generated motion and continuity can vary.

tools.name: Pika
tools.description: Create short AI videos and playful visual effects.
tools.bestFor: Animate an image or explore a short creative clip.
tools.consider: Available effects and generation limits change by plan.

tools.name: Synthesia
tools.description: Create presenter-style videos from scripts using AI avatars and voices.
tools.bestFor: Make an explainer or training presentation with a virtual presenter.
tools.consider: Use avatars and voices only within the service’s consent rules.

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.description: Tools for avatar videos, video translation and localization.
tools.bestFor: Adapt a presenter video for another language or audience.
tools.consider: Review translated speech and obtain permission for likeness use.

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
tools.description: Explore AI-generated video and visual motion from creative prompts.
tools.bestFor: Prototype a cinematic scene or animate a visual idea.
tools.consider: Results may require multiple attempts to match your direction.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.description: Generate speech and work with voice, dubbing and audio tools.
tools.bestFor: Create a narrated demo or voiceover from a script.
tools.consider: Use only voices you have permission to reproduce.
tools.keywords: voice speech narrate voiceover dub audio

tools.name: Descript
tools.description: Edit audio and video through text-based workflows and AI assistance.
tools.bestFor: Edit a podcast or spoken recording using its transcript.
tools.consider: Review transcription accuracy before making final edits.
tools.keywords: podcast recording transcript edit audio video

tools.name: Suno
tools.description: Generate songs and musical ideas from prompts.
tools.bestFor: Sketch a song concept or experiment with a musical style.
tools.consider: Music licensing depends on the plan and current terms.

tools.name: AIVA
tools.description: An AI music assistant for composing and developing musical pieces.
tools.bestFor: Create instrumental ideas for a soundtrack.
tools.consider: Check ownership and licensing for the chosen subscription.

tools.name: Krisp
tools.description: AI-powered noise cancellation and tools for clearer conversations.
tools.bestFor: Reduce background noise during calls and recordings.
tools.consider: Supported applications and features vary by platform.
tools.keywords: noise meeting sound call audio clean

tools.name: Cursor
tools.description: An AI coding environment for understanding, writing and changing software.
tools.bestFor: Work on an existing codebase with contextual coding help.
tools.consider: Review changes and run tests before deploying.
tools.keywords: code coding debug developer software repository

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.description: AI coding assistance integrated with supported developer workflows.
tools.bestFor: Get help writing code and reviewing development tasks.
tools.consider: Generated code still needs security and correctness review.

tools.name: Replit
tools.description: A browser-based environment for building applications with AI assistance.
tools.bestFor: Prototype an app without first setting up a local environment.
tools.consider: Hosting, usage and deployment costs are separate considerations.
tools.keywords: app website code build prototype browser

tools.name: Lovable
tools.description: Build web application prototypes by describing what you want.
tools.bestFor: Turn a product idea into an interactive web prototype.
tools.consider: Validate authentication, data access and security before real use.
tools.keywords: website app build prototype no code

tools.name: v0
tools.description: Vercel’s AI tool for generating web interfaces and applications.
tools.bestFor: Create an interface starting from a written brief.
tools.consider: Review generated code and deployment settings.
tools.keywords: website interface ui frontend build code

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.description: AI assistance inside Notion for working with workspace information and tasks.
tools.bestFor: Find and develop information within a Notion workspace.
tools.consider: Connected sources and features depend on workspace permissions.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.description: Create presentations, documents and pages from an outline or prompt.
tools.bestFor: Turn an outline into a presentation draft.
tools.consider: Check facts, formatting and export options before presenting.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.description: Transcription and AI-assisted meeting notes for spoken conversations.
tools.bestFor: Turn a meeting into a searchable transcript and summary.
tools.consider: Get participants’ consent and check supported languages.

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.description: Record, transcribe and summarize supported meeting workflows.
tools.bestFor: Keep track of conversations and follow-up items.
tools.consider: Use with meeting participants’ permission; review summaries.
tools.keywords: meeting notes transcript summarize action items

tools.name: Zapier AI
tools.description: Build AI-assisted automations connecting supported apps and workflows.
tools.bestFor: Move information between apps and automate repetitive work.
tools.consider: Review connected-account permissions and automation usage limits.

tools.name: Manus
tools.description: A general-purpose agent for research and multi-step digital tasks.
tools.bestFor: Delegate a research brief or a task with several deliverables.
tools.consider: Review sources and outputs before relying on a completed task.

tools.name: Genspark
tools.description: An AI workspace combining research, content creation and task execution.
tools.bestFor: Develop a research-backed document or presentation in one workspace.
tools.consider: Available tools and usage allowances vary by plan.

tools.name: Lindy
tools.description: An AI teammate that works with connected business tools and recurring tasks.
tools.bestFor: Prepare reports and handle routine work across your apps.
tools.consider: Review account permissions and approvals for external actions.
tools.keywords: agent email inbox reports scheduling business

tools.name: Relevance AI
tools.description: A platform for configuring specialist AI agents and connected workflows.
tools.bestFor: Build an agent for a repeatable sales or operations task.
tools.consider: Test instructions and connected tools before unattended use.

tools.name: Gumloop
tools.description: Build AI agents and workflows that connect business applications.
tools.bestFor: Combine information gathering and processing in a reusable workflow.
tools.consider: Check integration permissions and per-run usage costs.

tools.name: n8n
tools.description: A workflow automation platform with AI-agent and app-integration capabilities.
tools.bestFor: Connect APIs and business tools into a custom AI workflow.
tools.consider: Self-hosting requires maintenance; cloud and model costs may apply.
tools.keywords: agent automation workflow api self hosted technical

tools.name: Make AI Agents
tools.description: Create agents within Make workflows to coordinate tasks across connected apps.
tools.bestFor: Add adaptive decisions to a visual business automation.
tools.consider: Test scenarios and limit the actions an agent can perform.

tools.name: Dust
tools.description: Build workplace AI agents connected to team knowledge and tools.
tools.bestFor: Give a team an assistant grounded in its internal information.
tools.consider: Configure data access carefully and verify generated answers.
tools.keywords: agent knowledge team documents internal search

tools.name: Taskade
tools.description: A workspace for AI agents, apps and automated project workflows.
tools.bestFor: Organize a project and automate repeatable team tasks.
tools.consider: Review workspace sharing and automation settings.
tools.keywords: agent project tasks team workflow planning

tools.name: StackAI
tools.description: An enterprise platform for building AI agents and document workflows.
tools.bestFor: Create an internal document-processing or knowledge assistant.
tools.consider: Confirm deployment options and data-handling requirements.
tools.keywords: agent enterprise documents knowledge workflow builder

tools.name: Voiceflow
tools.description: A platform for designing and deploying conversational chat and voice agents.
tools.bestFor: Build a customer-facing assistant with guided conversations.
tools.consider: Plan escalation to a person and review connected data access.
tools.keywords: agent chatbot voice customer support conversation

tools.name: Botpress
tools.description: Build AI customer-support agents using knowledge sources and integrations.
tools.bestFor: Create a support assistant that answers from your documentation.
tools.consider: Test answer quality and provide a human handoff for difficult cases.
